🏗️ How it works

Two cron jobs, three players, one set of rails

A morning job fans the market snapshot out to all three AIs in parallel — each runs the same research → decision → validate → order pipeline. An evening job pulls fresh NAV, orders, and the QQQ benchmark from the source of truth, then regenerates this static page. Same prompts, same tools, same validators — the model is the only variable.

flowchart TD CRON[Morning cron - 13:30 UTC Mon-Fri] ORCH[daily.py + market snapshot via yfinance] CRON --> ORCH CG[ChatGPT gpt-5-mini] CL[Claude haiku-4-5] GM[Gemini 2.5-flash] ORCH --> CG ORCH --> CL ORCH --> GM R[Research agent - up to 5 tool iterations] CG --> R CL --> R GM --> R TOOLS[Tools - get_history, get_news, get_financials, get_analyst_ratings, read_own_trades] R <--> TOOLS SR[submit_research - structured output] R --> SR D[Decision agent - no tools] SR --> D SD[submit_decision - action, ticker, amount, reason, confidence] D --> SD GATE{Validator - universe / min 5k / max 25 pct NAV / cash cap} SD --> GATE ALPACA[Alpaca paper - market order DAY TIF] LOG[(decisions.jsonl)] GATE --> ALPACA GATE --> LOG ALPACA --> LOG ECRON[Evening cron - 20:05 UTC Mon-Fri] EOD[eod.py] ECRON --> EOD NAVAI[NAV per AI from Alpaca] QQQ[QQQ benchmark from yfinance] ORD[Filled orders from Alpaca] EOD --> NAVAI EOD --> QQQ EOD --> ORD NLOG[(nav.jsonl)] OLOG[(orders.jsonl)] NAVAI --> NLOG QQQ --> NLOG ORD --> OLOG JINJA[Jinja2 render] NLOG --> JINJA OLOG --> JINJA LOG -.-> JINJA PAGES[GitHub Pages publish] JINJA --> PAGES classDef cron fill:#18181b,stroke:#18181b,color:#fff classDef orch fill:#fff,stroke:#a1a1aa,color:#18181b classDef chatgpt fill:#ecfdf5,stroke:#10b981,color:#065f46 classDef claude fill:#fff7ed,stroke:#f97316,color:#9a3412 classDef gemini fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#3b82f6,color:#1e40af classDef agent fill:#f5f3ff,stroke:#8b5cf6,color:#5b21b6 classDef tool fill:#fafafa,stroke:#a1a1aa,color:#3f3f46 classDef sentinel fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#f59e0b,color:#78350f classDef gate fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#dc2626,color:#7f1d1d classDef store fill:#fef9c3,stroke:#ca8a04,color:#713f12 classDef out fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#2563eb,color:#1e3a8a class CRON,ECRON cron class ORCH,EOD,JINJA orch class CG chatgpt class CL claude class GM gemini class R,D agent class TOOLS tool class SR,SD sentinel class GATE gate class LOG,NLOG,OLOG,NAVAI,QQQ,ORD store class ALPACA,PAGES out

🧩 Component reference

What each piece actually does

🌅 daily.py

Morning orchestrator. Pulls the market snapshot from yfinance, then invokes each provider in src/providers.py sequentially. Records the decision, tokens, and cost into decisions.jsonl. Guarded so redundant crons on the same day don't double-trade.

🌇 eod.py

Evening orchestrator. Pulls fresh NAV + open positions from each Alpaca account (marked to consolidated NMS close via yfinance, not the paper feed), snapshots QQQ, fetches every filled order, then rebuilds the static dashboard. Idempotent — safe to re-fire.

🧠 src/prompt.py

The two system prompts every AI sees — RESEARCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT and DECISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT. Identical wording, identical instructions. The only variable in the whole experiment is which model reads them.

🛠 src/tools.py

The 5-function toolkit: get_history, get_news, get_financials, get_analyst_ratings, read_own_trades. Shared JSON schema is exported to all three SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, google-genai) so every player calls the exact same functions with the exact same arguments.

🚧 src/decision.py

The central validator. Runs after each AI emits its decision: enforces universe membership, $5k minimum trade, 25%-of-NAV cap per position, and cash availability (patched mid-run when Claude silently used $23k of Alpaca margin — no more accidental leverage).

👥 src/providers.py

The 3-player registry. Each entry pairs an LLM module (llm_chatgpt.py, llm_claude.py, llm_gemini.py) with its own Alpaca paper credentials env vars and a display accent color.

💼 src/broker.py

Thin wrapper on alpaca-py. Submits market orders with DAY time-in-force, reads back the account cash + open positions. Same interface every AI uses — no special sauce per player.

🎨 src/dashboard.py

Jinja2 renderer. Aggregates nav.jsonl + decisions.jsonl + orders.jsonl into the 4-up KPI grid, the total-return chart, the Journal timeline, and the per-AI Recent orders panel. Writes to docs/index.html; GitHub Pages serves it.

🔢 Per-day call budget

Rough ceiling for a single trading day

21
LLM round-trips max
(≤7 per AI × 3)
30
Tool invocations max
(≤10 per AI, yfinance / local)
6
Structured outputs
(submit_research + submit_decision)
3
Alpaca order submits
(one per AI)

Actual usage is well under the ceiling — see the per-AI cost breakdown in the repo.

⚖️ Fairness manifest

What's identical across the three players

✓Prompts — same RESEARCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT and DECISION_SYSTEM_PROMPT
✓Tools — same 5 functions, same JSON Schema
✓Tool budget — 5 iterations max each
✓Structured output — sentinel tools for ChatGPT & Claude, native JSON mode for Gemini
✓Validators — universe, $5k min, 25% NAV cap, cash-only (no margin)
✓Starting capital — $100,000 paper cash each
✓Market data — yfinance, same snapshot per cron
✓Broker — Alpaca paper, market order, DAY TIF

Whatever advantage a model gets comes from its reasoning, not its harness.

🧱 Tech stack

No servers. No databases. Static output, git-versioned state.

🤖 LLMs
OpenAI gpt-5-mini ($0.25 / $2.00 per M)
Anthropic claude-haiku-4-5 ($1.00 / $5.00 per M)
Google gemini-2.5-flash ($0.30 / $2.50 per M)
📈 Market data
yfinance ≥ 0.2.63 — consolidated NMS closes so numbers match Yahoo / Google / Schwab (not Alpaca's IEX-only paper feed)
💼 Broker
alpaca-py ≥ 0.30 — three separate paper accounts, market orders, DAY TIF
⏰ Scheduler
GitHub Actions cron · 3 redundant fires per cycle so a runner backlog can't skip a day
💾 State
Plain JSONL committed to the repo: nav.jsonl, decisions.jsonl, orders.jsonl — full audit trail in git history
🎨 Templating
Jinja2 ≥ 3.1 — one HTML template rendered to docs/index.html
🖥 Frontend
Tailwind (CDN) · Chart.js (equity curves) · Mermaid (this diagram) — no build step, no bundler
🌐 Hosting
GitHub Pages (free) — dashboard is a single static HTML file, updated by the evening cron
🐍 Runtime
Python ≥ 3.11 · python-dotenv for secrets · runs on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest
🔐 Secrets
3 LLM API keys + 6 Alpaca creds (3 keys, 3 secrets) — all in GitHub Actions secrets, never in the repo
